name: real-estate
description: Reference plugins, skills and data connectors for commercial real estate workflows, one plugin per practice. Starts with brokerage sales for the Tampa Bay market.

plugins.name: brokerage-sales
plugins.description: Prospect, win the listing with a BOV, market it, and run the contract to close. Public-record research from the CRE Harness connector for Pinellas, Hillsborough, Pasco and Polk, with branded flyers, postcards and BOVs.

plugins.name: property-research
plugins.description: Recently sold properties and comps from county appraiser sales records for Pinellas and Hillsborough, via the CRE Harness connector.
